subject: general
question: Which of the following is a structural reform under the 1991 policy?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Privatization of public sector units**__.

**__Key Points__**

• The **New Economic Policy (NEP)** was launched in **July 1991** to pull the Indian economy out of a severe **Balance of Payments (BoP)** crisis and high **Inflation**. The policy categorized reforms into two groups: **Stabilization Measures** and **Structural Reform Measures**.

• **Structural Reform Measures** are long-term policies aimed at improving the efficiency of the economy and increasing international competitiveness by removing rigidities in various sectors. **Privatization of public sector units** is a core structural reform that involves reducing the role of the government in business and encouraging private ownership. **Hence, statement 3 is correct.**

• **Devaluation of the rupee** was a short-term **Stabilization Measure** undertaken in **1991** (specifically on **July 1** and **July 3**) to boost exports and discourage imports, thereby improving the **Foreign Exchange Reserves**. It is not classified as a structural reform. **Hence, statement 1 is incorrect.**
